hooks.checkpointCue.notice: This notice does not save or restore anything. For a message that changes nothing (a question, a greeting, a progress check) add nothing and continue.
hooks.checkpointCue.resume: After compaction, resume or fork, if earlier decisions or remaining work are not visible in the conversation, call inspect_context first and load a DEFER candidate with load_context, then check it against the latest request.
hooks.checkpointCue.save: If this user message is a correction, a new decision, approval or prohibition, more work, or a scope change, do two things before answering or using the next tool: (1) re-decide the skill selection for the changed goal, scope and risk, and call any newly needed skill now; (2) save the user's own words and the changed remaining work with checkpoint_context.
hooks.checkpointCue.status:
[AGS turn check]
{state, select, missing {No prior save: this notice does not restore content lost to compaction.} saved {This session's work record: present.} other {This session's work record: none.}}
hooks.editGate.denied: [AGS] Changing a {limit, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} product file without a workflow: {paths}{earlier, plural, =0 {} one { (including # product file changed earlier)} other { (including # product files changed earlier)}}. Start a workflow first (minimal start call: {example}).
hooks.editGate.gatedRoot: [AGS] {path} is in the write scope of workflow root {rootId} ({state}), which awaits a decision, so it cannot be changed. Change it after that root is decided with resolve_convergence_gate, and keep working on parts that do not overlap.
hooks.editGate.outsideScope: [AGS] Changing a {limit, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} product file outside the writeTargets of the running workflows: {paths}{earlier, plural, =0 {} one { (including # product file changed earlier outside them)} other { (including # product files changed earlier outside them)}}. If this is a different task from the running work, start another workflow with writeTargets that do not overlap. One session can run several workflows together (minimal start call: {example}).
hooks.phaseCheck.continue: If this goal is not met yet, do not stop; continue the remaining work. Even when the request just received is done, continue while the goal remains. Record a stage result only after actually finishing that stage's work and verification, and do not stop at recording.
hooks.phaseCheck.pending: [AGS stage check] The running workflow has stages that are not passed yet: {stages}.
hooks.phaseCheck.startFailed: [AGS] A workflow start failed in this window. Cause codes: {codes}. The edit gate judged edits as usual.
hooks.phaseCheck.unavailable: [AGS] The workflow state could not be checked, so product file changes in this window were not blocked. Cause codes: {codes}.
hooks.phaseCheck.waiting: If you cannot proceed without the user's answer or approval, write in one line what you are waiting for and stop. Remove unneeded stages by revising the plan.
hooks.skillTrigger.invocation: Claude Code invocation: follow the common intake criteria in the MCP server instructions, and actually invoke each selected installed skill with the Skill tool or the /agent-governance-suite:<skill-name> command.
